{{CharInfobox |color={{castle color}} |corecolor={{castle color light}} |bordercolor={{castle color dark}} |name=Trevor |jname=トロバ |tmname=Trova |slogan=no |image=Trevor anime.png |size=300px |caption=Trevor |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Gray |hair=Orange |hometown=[[Lumiose City]] |region=[[Kalos]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=counterpart |counterpart=[[Trevor]] |anime=yes |epnum=XY039 |epname=Summer of Discovery! |enva=[[Michael Lockwood Crouch]] |java=[[Minami Fujii]] }} '''Trevor''' (Japanese: '''トロバ''' ''Trova'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and [[Photography|photographer]] from [[Lumiose City]] and a [[rival]] of {{Ash}}. ==History== ===''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''=== [[File:Summer Camp Team Squirtle.png|left|thumb|250px|Shauna, Trevor, and Tierno with their Pokémon]] Trevor debuted in ''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'' along with {{an|Shauna}} and {{an|Tierno}}, and his {{TP|Trevor|Charmander}}. After {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} saw the complete [[Kanto first partner Pokémon]] trio, Trevor came down from the stairs, exhausted from chasing Charmander. Later, he had a {{pkmn|battle}} with Clemont and his {{TP|Clemont|Chespin}}. The battle didn't continue after Chespin was accidentally burned by Charmander. In ''[[XY040|Day Three Blockbusters!]]'', Trevor [[Fishing|fished]] a {{p|Wailord}} during the {{DL|Pokémon Summer Camp|fishing competition}} which gave his team the win. He was also in a [[Pokévision]] video along with his teammates but did not win. In ''[[XY041|Foggy Pokémon Orienteering!]]'', Trevor, along with Team Squirtle and their rival team, Team Froakie, put aside their differences to find {{an|Bonnie}} and {{AP|Pikachu}}. In ''[[XY042|Battling Into the Hall of Fame!]]'', he had a {{DL|Pokémon battle|Team Battle}} with Ash, {{an|Serena}}, and Clemont. Despite putting up a great fight, Trevor was the first one to get defeated and then Shauna and Tierno got defeated afterwards. In ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]'', Trevor watched Serena competing in the [[Dendemille Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] Rookie Class along with Tierno and Shauna. In ''[[XY086|A Legendary Photo Op!]]'', Trevor met up with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in [[Mt. Molteau]]. He tried getting Charmeleon to calm down but it didn't work. He then battled Ash and lost. He revealed to the group that he sought out to take a picture of the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{p|Moltres}}, as he was able to get {{p|Articuno}} and {{p|Zapdos}}. He showed them pictures of Pokémon that were different than normal, such as {{p|Scatterbug}}'s hair length. Trevor and the group conducted their search on Mt. Molteau. Along the way, he got distracted by a {{p|Crustle}}. He eventually found Moltres at the top of Mt. Molteau when the battle with Team Rocket disturbed it from its slumber. He and the group took cover when Moltres began attacking them. Trevor then witnessed Ash's Fletchinder evolve into {{AP|Talonflame}} in an attempt to protect the group. After leaving Mt. Molteau, Trevor revealed that he succeeded in getting Moltres's picture and waved goodbye to Ash and his friends. [[File:Alain and Trevor.png|thumb|250px|Trevor and Alain]] In ''[[XY090|Tag Team Battle Inspiration!]]'', Trevor was seen taking a picture of a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Lairon}}. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Trevor watched the {{ci|Gloire}} Showcase Master Class on [[television]] along with Tierno. In ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]'', Trevor was revealed to have fulfilled the requirements to enter the [[Lumiose Conference]]. In the opening of the conference, he and Tierno were seen talking to Ash. The next day, he battled [[Alain]] in the first round and lost without [[Fainting|knocking out]] any of his Pokémon, leaving Trevor disappointed in himself. After losing, he decided to remain in Lumiose City to watch the rest of the League together with his friends, which he did up until ''[[XY131|Down to the Fiery Finish!]]''. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', Trevor joined the fight against [[Team Flare]]. [[Diantha]] tasked him, Shauna, Tierno and [[Sawyer]] with helping the citizens during the crisis. In ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]'', ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'', and ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'', he watched the crisis unfold on television in a Pokémon Center. He later reappeared in ''[[XY138|The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!]]'' to watch the performance that Serena put on to boost morale. In ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]'', Trevor and the rest of his group were watching the [[wild Pokémon]] who had escaped Lumiose City during the Team Flare incident. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN116|Pride of a Champion!]]'', Trevor appeared watching the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match between {{an|Lance}} and [[Diantha]] on TV, alongside Sawyer, Tierno, and Shauna. ==Character== [[File:Kalos rivals JN.png|thumb|left|250px|Trevor and his friends in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] Like his games counterpart, his goal as a Trainer is to meet every Pokémon in the [[Pokédex]] as stated during his introduction. Throughout his {{pkmn|journey}}, Trevor aims to take pictures of all the Pokémon he encounters. He is mostly interested in ones with differences in their features, however slight, as seen in ''[[XY086|A Legendary Photo Op!]]''. Trevor shares a close friendship with {{an|Tierno}} and {{an|Shauna}} as they been friends since they were little, and would met up with each other whenever they could during their journeys to pursue their goals. Trevor also has feelings for {{an|Serena}} as he saw her [[Pokévision]] video many times before meeting her.
